_comment: MusicLens recommendation engine configuration. All weights are documented starting values — not evidence-based tuned values. Tune after running the Phase 3 offline evaluation (ml/evaluation/evaluate.py). Do not adjust based on anecdotal feedback alone.

retrieval._comment: candidate_limit: how many tracks are scored before MMR reranking. Must be > final limit. Higher = better coverage, slower CPU.
retrieval._comment_mode: representation_mode controls which user vector feeds retrieval. 'auto' = use enhanced taste_representation when quality status is 'developing' or 'established'; fall back to preference_vector otherwise. 'enhanced' forces taste_representation. 'baseline' forces preference_vector.
retrieval._comment_quality: Minimum profile quality status required to use the enhanced taste_representation path. Statuses in ascending order: insufficient_data < limited < developing < established.

ranking._comment: Weights must sum to 1.0. These are starting-point values; adjust after evaluation. audio_similarity and representation_similarity together dominate; genre/artist/popularity/novelty are secondary signals.
ranking._comment_baseline: Weights used when falling back to baseline_content_recommender mode (no PCA representation available). Only audio_similarity, popularity_prior and novelty are meaningful without a representation space.

diversity._comment: MMR lambda: 1.0 = pure relevance, 0.0 = pure diversity. 0.72 balances discovery with relevance.
diversity._comment_artist: Hard cap: at most this many tracks from the same artist in the final list.
diversity._comment_genre: Soft penalty applied per additional track that shares a genre with already-selected tracks. Accumulates linearly.

novelty._comment: inverse_log_catalog_popularity: novelty = 1 - log1p(pop*100)/log(101). Tracks with popularity~0 score ~1.0; popularity=100 scores ~0.0.

history_filtering._comment: Controls which of the user's known tracks are excluded from recommendations.
history_filtering._comment_matched: When true, excludes all user_tracks rows with match_status IN ('matched','ambiguous') and confidence >= min_confidence_to_exclude.
history_filtering._comment_limit: Maximum rows loaded from user_tracks for history filtering. Larger = better filtering, more DB read.

cold_start._comment: Explicit fallback chain. Each stage is attempted in order; the first that yields a valid vector is used.
cold_start._comment_popularity: When all personalized fallbacks fail, return the top-N catalog tracks by popularity. These are clearly labeled as non-personalized.

explanation._comment: Controls explanation generation. signal_threshold: minimum signal value to mention a factor in the narrative. All threshold values are in [0, 1] normalized space.
